Headline: Front-End Engineer & Team Lead
Summary: My work has taken me from PHP portals and mobile APIs to online course platforms and front-end team leadership. I’m based in Jakarta and now work primarily with React, Next.js, and TypeScript.\nAt PT. Griya Mitra Digital, I develop client portals and admin panels, plan sprint work, and review the team’s pull requests. Working with backend and product teams is part of that day-to-day responsibility, alongside writing and maintaining the front-end code.\nMy personal projects explore two different interests: everyday organization and learning through play. Catat Saja brings notes, tasks, and finances together, with sharing and support for multiple currencies. Coba Lagi introduces children to coding with visual puzzles and spoken instructions.
